title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
  • Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
  • Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.
Requirements
  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
  • Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, JavaScript/TypeScript for dApps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
  • Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
  • Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
  • Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities.
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
  • Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
  • Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
  • Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.


If you're a blockchain developer excited to build tools for creative Web3 collaboration, send your resume to We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity.

title: Privacy Counsel (Full Time, Remote Position)
description:
About VeraSafe:

VeraSafe is an innovative and successful U.S. headquartered privacy and cybersecurity compliance consulting firm and law firm. Due to rapid growth and increased demand for our international privacy and technology compliance and legal services, VeraSafe is seeking creative, motivated, and collaborative attorneys to join our team, regardless of prior work experience or education background. Watch / listen to learn more about VeraSafe: Check out our podcast!

Apple Podcast :

YouTube :

Spotify:


VeraSafe is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work©, with 96% of our employees affirming that we are truly a great place to work . This means we foster trust, collaboration, and a positive work environment. We are committed to maintaining this standard of meaningful work, work-life balance, and a supportive community. Check out our great benefits, listed at the end of this job description.


VeraSafe frequently hires for attorney and consultant positions on a rolling basis. We are growing rapidly and seek to proactively build a strong talent pool to meet sustained, increasing client demand.


About the Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for an attorney with 4-6 years of experience who wants to join a team working on the cutting edge of privacy and data protection, and who wants to further develop a practice in an in-demand, high-tech area of law. We are inundated with business from clients who love the way we advise on privacy compliance (hence the need for you!).


While this role requires professional experience in privacy law , we are prepared to welcome you to our team with a robust and established onboarding and training process. We typically advance people more quickly than your typical law firm, and we do it on an individual basis (no lockstep promotions or compensation).


Note : We include skills assessments in the recruitment for this position. We know this is a burden, but we think it’s worth it, and we appreciate you taking the time to complete it. We’ve found it enables us to find the best attorneys, regardless of their experience, where they went to law school, or where they were trained. We want smart, kind, creative lawyers, plain and simple, and this assessment is a crucial part of our ability to hire this way.


We are not your typical legal job. We use project managers to keep our remote team organized and our projects streamlined and on-track. We encourage our team members to travel and to make use of our ability to work as digital nomads, whether that means spending a few months abroad or on extended trips to be near family. We collaborate closely (you won’t feel like you’re working in isolation) and we actively encourage sharing of credit for work well done, resources, and advice (and penalize the reverse). We are not biglaw. We do top-notch work for interesting clients, yet we pride ourselves on our team members being happy, with time and energy for a life outside of work, which we believe makes us better attorneys who don’t burn out.


The bottom line: If you want to learn or go deeper practicing privacy law, if you want to practice in a problem-solving environment focused on giving excellent and yet actionable advice, if you want to work with a global team of friendly, brilliant people, if you want the flexibility to work in a way that makes sense to you, please apply!


Responsibilities Include:

  • Assessing client information systems for compliance with data protection laws and regulations
  • Drafting data protection agreements, addenda, and amendments
  • Advising clients on privacy-related product improvements
  • Researching legal issues and composing legal opinions/memoranda
  • Writing privacy law related articles and blog posts
  • Assisting in the development of in-house legal templates
  • Contributing to the development of internal procedures and methodologies
  • Collaborating with a team of intellectual peers who value cooperation and community


What We Need From You

Need to Have:

  • License to practice law (active and in good standing) in your jurisdiction
  • Experience in privacy/data protection of 4-6 years or experience in the field of life sciences of at least 4 years
  • Team player, interested in contributing to a growing enterprise
  • Strong writing/editing skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work remotely
  • Willingness to learn new skills and receive direction and feedback from partners
  • Willingness to pursue privacy certifications (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPM)


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working in a law firm
  • Previous contract drafting and negotiation experience
  • Privacy certifications of some kind (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPP/US, specialty from law school, etc.)
  • Professional involvement in the privacy and/or data security space (attendance at privacy conferences; membership or publication in the IAPP, etc.)


Key Competencies:

  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a strong work ethic
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable using a variety of software applications
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage your own schedule in order to work successfully with international teams and meet deadlines

VeraSafe’s Excellent Benefits Include:

Other Benefits:

How to apply

Send an English resume and links to relevant work (repos, API docs, architectural notes, or write-ups) showing:

title: Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant SaaS)
description:
Our US-based client is looking for a full-time, remote Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant SaaS) with 7+ years of experience. The role focuses on designing and building the backend services and integrations that enable secure, scalable, multi-tenant embedded analytics within a SaaS platform.


This role sits at the intersection of application engineering, identity management, and the data platform. The primary focus is on integrating embedded analytics tools into a multi-tenant application with strict tenant isolation, SSO-based access control, and high-concurrency usage patterns.

While AWS QuickSight is the primary BI platform, we are open to candidates with experience embedding other modern, multi-tenant analytics solutions (such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Mode, or Superset). The emphasis is on a strong understanding of how embedded analytics work in SaaS environments, rather than on expertise in a single tool.

This is a senior-level role with meaningful influence over analytics architecture, security considerations, and integration standards across the platform.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement multi-tenant embedded analytics within customer-facing SaaS applications
  • Build backend services that generate and manage embed sessions, URLs, and permissions dynamically per tenant and user
  • Implement SSO and identity propagation (Auth0, Cognito, OIDC) to enforce tenant-aware access and role-based controls
  • Ensure row-level and dataset-level security is consistently applied across embedded analytics experiences
  • Partner with Analytics Engineers to align datasets, semantic models, and RLS logic with application roles
  • Translate analytics platform constraints into clean, reliable application-facing abstractions
  • Design and maintain tenant-aware APIs that abstract analytics tools behind stable, versioned interfaces
  • Build service-layer patterns that isolate application code from direct BI or warehouse dependencies
  • Implement caching, pagination, throttling, and batching strategies for high-concurrency analytics traffic
  • Ensure APIs gracefully handle tenant onboarding/offboarding and evolving analytics assets
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform Architect to design scalable backend patterns supporting hundreds of tenants
  • Optimize service-to-warehouse and service-to-analytics-tool interactions for latency and cost efficiency
  • Identify and mitigate failure modes in embedded analytics workflows (timeouts, permission drift, stale sessions)
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, integration diagrams, and design reviews
  • Enforce least-privilege access and tenant isolation across all analytics integrations
  • Ensure compliance with PII, data governance, and audit requirements in embedded reporting flows
  • Implement logging and audit trails for analytics access and permission changes
  • Partner with InfoSec to support security reviews and compliance initiatives
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for integration services and analytics-related configuration
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Support observability through CloudWatch, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry
  • Improve operational reliability through monitoring, alerting, and runbook development
  • Act as a technical owner for embedded analytics integrations
  • Partner with Product to shape analytics capabilities and roadmap decisions
  • Mentor mid-level engineers on integration patterns, security, and service design
  • Drive standards for analytics integration consistency and developer experience


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of backend or integration engineering experience in SaaS environments
  • Strong experience building backend services in Node.js, Python, or PHP
  • Hands-on experience embedding analytics or BI tools into multi-tenant applications
  • Strong understanding of SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and identity propagation
  • Experience implementing tenant-aware access controls (RLS, role mapping, dataset isolation)
  • Solid SQL knowledge and experience integrating with data warehouses
  • Proven experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment (AWS or equivalent)


Desired Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Experience embedding AWS QuickSight in multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Experience with other embedded analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Superset, Mode, etc.)
  • Familiarity with row-level security models and permission orchestration
  • Experience with Auth0 or Cognito in analytics contexts.
  • Knowledge of caching layers (Redis) and high-concurrency API design
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, or analytics access auditing


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·       Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·       5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·       Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·       Brazil-based (fully remote )

·       Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·       Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·       Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·       Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·       High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·       Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph  describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Consultor de Governança
description:
Buscamos um profissional para liderar a estruturação e a manutenção do nosso ecossistema de dados. O foco principal será a implementação e gestão do Unity Catalog , estabelecendo políticas de governança que garantam a segurança, conformidade e qualidade dos dados utilizados em modelos de Analytics e Inteligência Artificial.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Unity Catalog: Configurar e administrar o Unity Catalog (Databricks) para garantir o controle de acesso centralizado (lineage, permissões e auditoria).
  • Políticas de Governança: Desenvolver e implementar políticas de governança de dados e IA, garantindo que o ciclo de vida dos dados esteja em conformidade com normas (como LGPD) e boas práticas de mercado.
  • Documentação Técnica: Atuar ativamente na criação de catálogos de dados, dicionários, diagramas de linhagem e manuais de processos. A documentação será um pilar central da entrega.
  • Governança de IA: Estabelecer diretrizes para o uso ético e seguro de modelos de IA, monitorando a qualidade dos dados de entrada (inputs) e a rastreabilidade dos modelos.
  • Segurança e Acessos: Definir e gerenciar perfis de acesso, garantindo que a democratização dos dados ocorra de forma segura.
  • Colaboração: Atuar como ponte entre as equipes de Engenharia de Dados, Cientistas de Dados e Stakeholders de negócio para garantir a integridade da informação.


Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

  • Experiência sólida com Databricks e configuração de Unity Catalog .
  • Conhecimento profundo em SQL e linguagens utilizadas em ambiente de dados (Python ou Scala).
  • Vivência com frameworks de Governança de Dados (DAMA-DMBOK, COBIT ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Catálogo de Dados e Linhagem (Data Lineage).
  • Entendimento de fluxos de MLOps e governança aplicada a modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade excepcional em escrita técnica e documentação.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Databricks (Certified Data Engineer ou similar).
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de migração para ambientes de governança centralizada.


Perfil Desejado (Soft Skills)

  • Perfil Analítico: Capacidade de organizar grandes volumes de informação de forma lógica.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor com a padronização e qualidade da documentação.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Capacidade de explicar políticas complexas de forma simples para diferentes áreas.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Portuguese Speaking  Reporter  UK / Brazil
description:
Portuguese Speaking Reporter | €35K | Remote

We’re a global media and events leader at the centre of the iGaming B2B ecosystem — covering the technology, regulation, data, platforms, and commercial engines that power online gaming worldwide. This isn’t consumer‑facing content; it’s the heartbeat of the industry.

If you’re hungry to learn, thrive in fast‑paced news, and want to grow quickly in a sector that never stands still, this is your moment.

The Role

We’re looking for a sharp, ambitious Reporter to join our newsroom and help shape our editorial voice across Europe and Brazil.

You’ll cover daily iGaming news, support senior journalists, and—crucially—develop original stories that go beyond recycled press releases. This is an ideal first step for someone building a journalism career and eager to develop deep industry expertise.

What You’ll Do

  • Write and publish accurate, timely news across regulation, M&A, product launches, and market trends
  • Review, edit, and publish press releases for our B2B News Support package
  • Maintain high editorial standards, sourcing, and attribution
  • Optimise headlines, metadata, and internal linking
  • Build a source tracker and grow toward original reporting, exclusives, and first‑hand stories
  • Produce 4–6 high‑quality stories per week , with a focus on originality, insight, and fresh angles
  • Help shape our brand voice and act as a strong editorial ambassador
  • Contribute to educating and expanding our presence in the Brazilian market

What You Bring

  • Journalism or editorial experience
  • Fluent Portuguese (essential)
  • Proven experience in the iGaming sector (essential)
  • Strong grammar, accuracy, and headline instincts
  • Ability to turn press releases into engaging B2B news
  • Organised, reliable, and deadline‑driven
  • Based in the UK

What Sets You Apart

  • Strong iGaming industry contacts and a passion for uncovering first‑hand stories
  • Curiosity, motivation, and the confidence to pursue stories even when they challenge industry narratives
  • SEO knowledge
  • Ambition to build sources and break stories

What’s In It for You

  • Ownership of our Press Release Support product
  • Fast progression toward explainers, features, and exclusives
  • A real opportunity to shape editorial identity and influence a fast‑growing brand

Benefits

  • Private health insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programme & retail discounts
  • Flexible, remote‑friendly working

Why Join Us

You’ll be part of a fast‑growing, ambitious team where your work is seen, valued, and genuinely impactful. We champion curiosity, initiative, and growth — and we’ll support you in becoming a trusted voice in iGaming journalism, with a meaningful role in shaping how the industry is understood across Europe and Brazil.

title: Product Owner
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


About This Opportunity

As a Product Owner, you will work closely with both our Business Intelligence and Reporting Teams. In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.


The ideal candidate will have experience with Scrum/ Agile processes, Accounting/Financial Systems, SSRS, PowerBI, and Tableau. Knowledge of ETL and Oracle/Oracle EBS is a plus.


Professional English Language skills are required.


Position is CLT and fully remote (must reside in Brazil). Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for Internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!



Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Finance & Accounting leadership and BI teams on product backlog and coordinate with various technology teams across InComm to implement new solutions.
  • Build, manage and prioritize product backlog based on the overall strategy and business objectives for future product development.
  • Responsible for creating and/or managing following artifacts:

-Road Map

-Development Backlog

-User Stories and Sprint Tasks

-Supporting documents for user stories


  • Monitor and Review ServiceNow (SNOW) requests
  • Create product vision and roadmap which accomplishes the goal of the vision and convey that vision to the scrum team.
  • Ensure user stories are well defined and ready for development to begin.
  • Responsible for optimizing the value of the work done.
  • Accountable for each stage of the development process and the final product.
  • Ensure close collaboration with development team. Be available to address any questions team members have regarding requirements or implementation of a product feature.
  • Responsible for communicating with stakeholders across the board, including product managers, leadership, customers, and the development team to make sure their vision is aligned with business objectives.


Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experience with reporting and operations within Billing, Accounting, and Sales
  • Experience working in Agile/Technical environments
  • Skilled in and comfortable working alongside technical stakeholders, translating business needs into clear, actionable inputs for development or support teams.
  • Proficient in Agile/Scrum

  • General knowledge of ERP, Databases (Oracle & MS SQL) and DataLakesis a plus
  • SRS, PowerBI, and Tableau and knowledge of ETL.

title: Visual Effects Artist
description:
Who we are:


Apex Systems is a leading professional services organization focused on providing solutions with real business value. We provide a customer-focused approach to building authentic partnerships with our clients.


We are seeking a VFX Artist to join the team supporting an international world-wide gaming client and the next‑generation evolution of the franchise

This role will focus on real‑time VFX for core gameplay and visuals, helping deliver next‑gen quality while meeting sprint‑based production needs.


We’re looking for someone with a strong sense of dramatic, dynamic visual effects, a critical eye for timing and motion, and the technical ability to bring these effects to life inside Unreal Engine.

You’ll work closely with a small, collaborative team, contribute to a mix of styles ranging from stylized to ESPN‑inspired sports broadcast polish, and help push the Client's visuals forward.


In This Role, You Will:


  • Execute high‑quality real‑time VFX for the client.
  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.


About the Project:


This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:


  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities


  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.


Requirements


  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.
  • Ability to create all components needed for VFX (textures, meshes, materials, prototypes).
  • Strong sense of timing, weight, animation principles, and motion.
  • Eager to keep learning.


Nice to have


  • Experience with Call of Duty–style FX sensibilities (timing, punch, clarity).
  • Strong animation fundamentals — especially movement, impact, and timing.
  • Experience shipping multiple titles in the game industry.
  • Desire to grow pipelines, tools, and collaborative processes.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Hello from RE Partners!

The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


Senior Data Engineer


This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.


Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
  • Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
  • Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
  • Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
  • Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
  • Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.


Accountable for:

  • Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.
  • Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
  • Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
  • Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
  • GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
  • Hands on Java experience
  • Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
  • Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
  • Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
  • Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
  • Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
  • Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
  • Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
  • Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.


Preferred skills and experience:

  • Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
  • Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
  • Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
  • Embrace change with a positive outlook.
  • Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.



Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus

See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer

£70,000 - £90,000

Remote - Brazil (You will need to work UK time zone)


You already know how to build software that works.


What you might be missing is the chance to build something that matters, where the details count and the users notice when you get it right.


This role is for an engineer who cares how things look, how they behave, and how they hold up when real money and real users are involved.


Why you’ll love it here:

  • You’ll own real parts of the product, not just tickets
  • The UI has to be precise and trusted, not “close enough”
  • You’ll work across the full stack with real influence over decisions
  • The product sits between traditional finance expectations and onchain systems
  • You’ll build for institutional and high net worth users who demand clarity and reliability


Who this isn’t for:

This isn’t a role for someone who wants a narrow remit, loose UI standards, or to ship features without thinking end to end.


If you prefer clear tickets, minimal ownership, or letting AI do the thinking for you, this will feel uncomfortable.


Day to day:

You’ll be building and refining a production platform used to manage onchain assets.


That means turning product direction and designs into polished, accurate UI, then wiring it properly into APIs, databases, and background workflows.


The split is genuinely full stack. You’ll spend meaningful time on the frontend, but you’re also expected to contribute confidently on the backend so features are built end to end, not in isolation.


Performance, maintainability, and correctness matter because this platform is already live and evolving.


The Business:

The business is a FinTech fund building onchain banking infrastructure for institutional capital.

It operates where stablecoins, DeFi lending, automation, and risk management meet.


The focus is usability and trust, bringing institutional-grade expectations into onchain finance, with active engagement from major financial institutions.


Requirements:

  • Strong full stack experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript
  • Proven ability to ship precise, production-quality UI
  • Solid SQL knowledge with Postgres and an ORM such as Prisma
  • Experience designing APIs and backend workflows, including orchestration tools like Temporal
  • Understanding of ERC-4626 and DeFi lending markets such as Aave or Morpho
  • Confident, structured use of LLM tools like Cursor or Claude Code
  • FinTech experience preferred
  • Able to travel freely across Europe


If you want ownership, technical breadth, and the chance to build a mature system people genuinely rely on, this is worth a conversation.

title: Senior Splunk Engineer
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Splunk Engineer to take over and operate the on-premise Splunk SIEM platform. As part of the transition from Infosys, you will be responsible for stabilizing and continuously improving an existing enterprise-scale SIEM environment.


You will own all Splunk operations across Plan & Build, 24/7 Operations, Release & Patch Management, CIM-based Log Onboarding, Parser development, Hardening, Configuration Management, and Incident/Problem/Change processes.


Responsibilities

1. Plan & Build

  • Perform CIM-compliant log onboarding, parser creation, documentation.
  • Conduct onboarding due diligence and demand analysis.
  • Create Firewall/VPN/Routing change requests and validate changes.
  • Manage ingestion pipelines via Cribl, Syslog-ng (TLS), Splunk UF/HF, SCP.
  • Deploy and scale Splunk components using Terraform and Ansible.
  • Build trend and capacity analyses.


2. Operations (24/7 enterprise-grade operations)

  • Ensure full Splunk platform operation, monitoring, performance, EPS/log flow.
  • Handle Incidents, Service Requests, Changes, and Problems under MBG ITSM.
  • Lead Major Incident Management (P1/P2) with 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • Build and operate Health Check dashboards and QA reports.


3. Configuration & Release Management

  • Implement approved changes across Splunk components.
  • Perform daily configuration backups (KV stores, Apps, Configs).
  • Maintain automation libraries (Terraform, Ansible, scripts).
  • Manage Splunk patching and releases (maintain N-1 level).
  • Support up to 12 minor + 1 major release per year.


4. Security, Hardening & Compliance

  • System hardening and vulnerability remediation.
  • Operate via secure access methods (Jump hosts, SuSSHi, 2FA).
  • Conduct vulnerability scans and support SOC threat analysis.
  • Automate SOP-based operational workflows.


5. Transition

  • Take over existing MBG Splunk operations.
  • Validate and enhance current configurations, parsers, and deployments.
  • Ensure stability during transition and hypercare.


Requirements

Technical Skills

  • 5–10 years Splunk/SIEM experience in large enterprises.
  • Expertise in Splunk Architecture, CIM onboarding, parser development, Syslog-ng, certificates.
  • Strong scripting: Terraform, Ansible, Bash/Python.
  • Experience stabilizing existing SIEM environments.



Certifications (required)

Minimum two of:

  • Splunk Core Certified User
  • Splunk Core Certified Power User
  • Splunk Enterprise Admin
  • Splunk Enterprise Architect
  • Optional: Splunk ES


Soft Skills

  • Strong communication in enterprise environments.
  • Clear documentation skills.
  • Proactive, quality-driven work style.
  • Fluent English (German beneficial).

description:

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 10+ months (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Team Overview

The GRC Systems team provides the technology foundation that supports long-running, human-driven Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes. The team delivers authoritative data and scalable tools that enable partners across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to reason effectively, make informed decisions, and answer complex compliance questions.

We focus on deeply understanding user workflows and eliminating manual effort by stitching fragmented experiences into seamless, end-to-end journeys.


Role Overview

As a GRC Systems Administrator , you will serve as the primary service owner for AuditBoard and Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) . This role bridges business process and technical configuration, ensuring GRC platforms are not only stable and reliable, but continuously evolving to meet organizational complexity and growth.


You will operate in a Build and Run model—leading new configurations and enhancements while also owning day-to-day system administration, user access, and vendor management. You will work closely with Audit, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable low-code/no-code solutions that improve efficiency and user experience.


Key Responsibilities

Platform Administration & Configuration

  • Own the daily administration of AuditBoard and Archer Evolv, including configuration of modules, workflows, fields, layouts, notifications, and automation.
  • Ensure system stability, data integrity, and optimal performance across platforms.
  • Manage complex role-based access control (RBAC), user permissions, and access governance to ensure appropriate data visibility.


Stakeholder Partnership

  • Engage regularly with internal users across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to gather feedback and identify friction points.
  • Translate ambiguous or evolving business requirements into clear, actionable system configurations and improvements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on platform capabilities and best practices.


Vendor & Service Ownership

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for GRC platform vendors.
  • Manage vendor relationships, support tickets, escalations, and service delivery commitments.
  • Advocate for platform enhancements and roadmap priorities aligned with business needs.


Project Delivery

  • Plan and manage multiple concurrent configuration initiatives, including new module rollouts, regulatory standards onboarding, and process enhancements.
  • Drive projects end-to-end—from requirements gathering and design through testing, deployment, and user enablement.


Documentation & Enablement

  • Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for system configurations and administrative processes.
  • Develop user guides, training materials, and release notes to support adoption of new features and workflows.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in systems administration or SaaS platform administration
  • Deep hands-on experience with AuditBoard or comparable GRC SaaS platforms
  • Experience administering Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) or similar Regulatory Change Management solutions
  • Strong proficiency in low-code/no-code configuration within enterprise SaaS tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholders and translate loosely defined business problems into concrete technical solutions
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, including support escalations and feature advocacy


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with REST API concepts and SaaS integrations (e.g., integrations with Jira, Slack, or identity providers)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AuditBoard Certified Administrator or similar)
  • Experience working in agile environments with two-week sprint cycles
  • Background in high-growth or fast-scaling organizations where processes are still being defined

title: Thumbnail Designer (Art Director)  - Crypto Media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!


Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain \"Brilliance or Nothing\" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and \"breaking\" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the \"click\" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the \"Stream Team\" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and \"elite\" visual identity across all platforms.



Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and \"breaking\" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted \"fellow degen\" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

title: Mainframe Project Manager
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Mainframe experiente para liderar e supervisionar projetos complexos de mainframe, garantindo execução bem-sucedida e integração fluida com os processos de negócio. O candidato ideal terá sólida experiência em tecnologias de Mainframe, incluindo z/OS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, REXX e SAS , além de forte vivência em gestão de projetos, gestão de stakeholders, avaliação de riscos e otimização de custos .

Esta função exige habilidades excepcionais de liderança para inspirar equipes, construir relacionamentos com as partes interessadas e impulsionar melhorias de processos.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver planos de projeto abrangentes, definir escopo, estabelecer cronogramas realistas e gerenciar recursos de forma eficaz.
  • Aplicar expertise em tecnologias de Mainframe Broadcom e IBM, incluindo subsistemas, JCL, COBOL e REXX.
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders-chave, incluindo líderes de negócio, equipes técnicas e usuários finais.
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, identificar riscos potenciais e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação e planos de contingência.
  • Alocar recursos de forma eficiente, acompanhar despesas e otimizar custos, garantindo o sucesso do projeto.
  • Liderar equipes de projeto, promovendo colaboração e definindo direções claras.
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, assegurando aderência aos planos e cronogramas definidos.
  • Manter canais de comunicação eficazes, gerenciar expectativas dos stakeholders e tratar preocupações de forma ágil.
  • Negociar contratos, acompanhar entregáveis e garantir colaboração eficiente com fornecedores.
  • Avaliar o impacto de migrações de mainframe nos processos e fluxos de trabalho existentes, assegurando transições suaves.
  • Conduzir melhorias de processos e implementar boas práticas de gestão de mudanças.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • z/OS, AS400: Proficiência avançada em sistemas operacionais de mainframe.
  • ITIL, COBOL, JCL, SAS, REXX: Sólido conhecimento prático de linguagens, controle de jobs e scripts em mainframe.
  • Gestão de Projetos e Stakeholders: Forte capacidade de gerenciar projetos de grande escala e engajar stakeholders de forma eficaz.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Capacidade de avaliar e mitigar riscos, mantendo parcerias com fornecedores.
  • Orçamento e Previsão Financeira: Experiência em gestão financeira de projetos, otimização de custos e planejamento de recursos.
  • Gestão de Mudanças e Melhoria de Processos: Proficiência na implementação de estratégias de change management e melhorias contínuas.
  • Gestão de Equipes: Fortes habilidades de liderança para orientar, desenvolver e motivar equipes técnicas.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • DB2, IMS, Oracle, MySQL: Experiência em gerenciamento de bancos de dados em ambientes de mainframe.

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: MS D365 CRM Functional Consultant
description:
We never request payment at any stage of our recruitment process, and we only contact candidates through official corporate accounts and platforms. About TMF Group

TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing worldwide. We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.



Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

If you are an experienced Microsoft D365 CRM Functional Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions tailored to business needs.
  • Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.
  • Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.
  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants when needed.


Key Requirements

  • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.
  • Experience with version 8.0 or later.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience developing custom workflows, entities and plugins using C# or .NET .
  • Strong understanding of D365 CRM’s data model, security model and configuration options.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment.



What’s in It for You?

Career Development

  • Opportunities for internal mobility and career progression.
  • Collaboration with global colleagues and exposure to international clients.
  • Continuous learning supported by the TMF Business Academy.

Making an Impact

  • Direct contribution to simplifying global business operations for our clients.
  • Opportunities to support local communities through our corporate social responsibility initiatives.

A Supportive Environment

  • A strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.
  • Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‑life balance.
  • An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.

At TMF Group, our people define who we are . We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.
