title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Analista de Prompt e IA
description:
Analista de Prompt e IA - Remoto


Sobre a Vaga


A Descanso Médico está em busca de um talento híbrido: alguém que tenha facilidade com escrita de prompt e, ao mesmo tempo, seja um entusiasta de tecnologia e automações. Você será o braço direito na implementação dos nossos agentes de IA para médicos, garantindo que a tecnologia \"fale a língua\" do consultório e converta leads em pacientes.


O Perfil que buscamos

Esta é uma vaga ideal para quem está começando na área de tecnologia/IA, estudantes de Sistemas de Informação, Marketing Digital ou entusiastas de ferramentas No-Code que buscam crescimento rápido em uma startup.


E o melhor: totalmente remota e sem carga horária fixa. Temos clientes em processo de onboarding e em fase de suporte e a tarefa desse analista é dar suporte.


Suas missões principais:

  Configuração de Agentes (Onboarding): Traduzir as necessidades do médico (via formulários que receberá) em prompts lógicos e eficientes.


  Ajuste Fino (Suporte): Receber demandas (poucas vezes por semana) e \"calibrar\" as IAs para que elas fiquem cada vez mais inteligentes.


  Olhar Crítico (TI): Como você estará na linha de frente, esperamos que você nos ajude a identificar falhas em integrações e sugira melhorias nos fluxos (Ex: \"E se a gente integrasse o Typeform com o WhatsApp via API?\").


Requisitos (O pé no chão)


  Curiosidade Tecnológica: Você não precisa ser programador, mas precisa amar fuçar em ferramentas novas e entender o que é uma API ou um Webhook.


  Escrita Excelente: Você vai escrever em nome de médicos. O tom de voz deve ser profissional e acolhedor.


  Lógica de Processos: Capacidade de desenhar um fluxo de atendimento (Se o paciente diz X, a IA responde Y).


Qualificações Desejadas


  Domínio de LLMs: Experiência profunda com modelos GPT, Claude ou similares, entendendo parâmetros como temperatura, top-p e system messages.


  Raciocínio Lógico & TI: Conhecimento básico/intermediário sobre como funcionam integrações (APIs), ferramentas de automação (Make, n8n ou Zapier) e lógica de programação.


Visão de Produto & TI (O Diferencial)


  Palpites Técnicos: Analisar nossa arquitetura atual e sugerir melhorias em integrações (APIs, Webhooks, fluxos de dados).


  Inovação: Propor novas funcionalidades para a plataforma que melhorem a experiência do cliente e a eficiência da IA.


  Automação: Colaborar no desenho de fluxos lógicos que conectam o prompt às ferramentas de gestão e tráfego pago


Remuneração e Benefícios

Base Fixa de 1 Salário Mínimo + Variavel (Bonificação por setup de novo cliente + prêmio por performance/suporte)


  Oportunidade: Você vai aprender na prática sobre a \"profissão do futuro\" (Prompt Engineering) e ter acesso direto à estratégia de uma startup de saúde.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from \"Bronze\" (Raw) to \"Silver\" (Cleaned) and \"Gold\" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.


Qualifications


Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Product Designer Pleno, você será a ponte entre as necessidades de negócio de um grande player do setor de infraestrutura e as dores dos usuários finais. Seu papel é garantir que cada funcionalidade desenvolvida seja intuitiva, tecnicamente viável e visualmente impecável, elevando a maturidade de design dentro de um ecossistema complexo e dinâmico.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Trabalhar próximo aos times de Engenharia, Produto e áreas de negócio para definir e desenvolver soluções eficazes e novas funcionalidades;
  • Identificar pontos de fricção e oportunidades em processos complexos (como faturamento, chamados técnicos ou serviços de gás);
  • Conduzir pesquisas, entrevistas com usuários e testes de usabilidade para validar hipóteses antes da implementação;
  • Liderar dinâmicas de brainstorm e workshops de co-criação com stakeholders;
  • Aplicar princípios de Gestalt, tipografia e hierarquia visual para entregar interfaces de alto nível.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Apresentação de casos reais, processos de pensamento e entregas visuais com um portfólio online atualizado;
  • Experiência sólida com design de interação, definição de fluxos e prototipação funcional;
  • Experiência prática em entrevistas, testes de usabilidade e métodos como card sorting e avaliação heurística;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar com bibliotecas de componentes e manter a consistência visual;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em Design Thinking, Lean UX e metodologias centradas no usuário;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida em São Paulo/SP;
  • Graduação ou cursos especializados em Design, UX ou áreas correlatas;
  • Familiaridade com princípios de acessibilidade (diretrizes WCAG) para garantir produtos inclusivos para todos os perfis de usuários;
  • Capacidade de argumentar e defender soluções de design baseadas em dados e evidências junto a stakeholders.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tver experiência em consultoria, com facilidade para transitar entre diferentes contextos e lidar com stakeholders seniores;
  • Já tiver atuado com Design Systems, participando da criação ou manutenção de guias de estilo e bibliotecas escaláveis;
  • Possuir background no setor de Gás e Energia, com compreensão das particularidades, termos técnicos e fluxos de atendimento do segmento de utilities;
  • Tiver perfil analítico, com conhecimento em métricas de uso e ferramentas de análise para embasar decisões de design;
  • Já tiver visão de Produto, atuando lado a lado com PMs na definição de KPIs e priorização de roadmap.

Na Hyatt, somos movidos pelo propósito de \"cuidar das pessoas para que elas possam ser o seu melhor\".


Nossa promessa está em entregarmos grandes experiências para nossos clientes, colegas e para a sociedade baseada em nossos valores.



· Ser íntegro nos torna diferentes pois estamos prontos para falar e aceitar a verdade, honrando com os compromissos, responsabilidades e orgulho;

· Somos empáticos pois antes de qualquer coisa, nos colocamos no lugar das pessoas com compaixão e honestidade;

· Buscamos a todo instante ver as coisas de uma forma diferente, nos tornando criativos, curiosos e experimentando sem medo. Acreditamos que as falhas existem e são elas que nos levam ao sucesso mais cedo;

· Prezamos por um ambiente de descontração, rimos alto e geramos a alegria em nosso ambiente de trabalho. Cultivar um ambiente saudável, alegre e de bem estar é a chave para um serviço de excelência!


Sobre a oportunidade:


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Monitoramento de Canais de Comunicação - Acompanhar e analisar os canais de comunicação interna, fornecendo melhorias para otimizar a interação entre os colaboradores;
  • Criação de Conteúdo – Sugerir e redigir conteúdos para canais internos, como murais, e-mails, newsletters e redes sociais corporativas;
  • Apoio em Campanhas e Eventos Internos - Participar da organização e execução de campanhas de endomarketing, datas comemorativas e eventos internos. Fazer contato com fornecedores externos;
  • Produção de Materiais Visuais - Desenvolver materiais gráficos e visuais para apoio à comunicação interna;
  • Organizar e manter atualizado o banco de dados de documentos, imagens e informações da área de comunicação interna;
  • Realizar atividades administrativas relacionadas ao setor, como agendamento de salas e apoio nos processos internos. Controle do estoque de brindes.


Requisitos:


  • Ensino superior cursando em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Jornalismo, Design e/ou adjacentes;
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de edição de fotos e vídeos (Adobe, Photoshop, Premier, Canvas);
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar 6 horas diárias.


Benefícios:


  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Vale Transporte ou Auxílio combustível de acordo com as suas necessidades;

Pensamos em benefícios que impactem positivamente o bem-estar e saúde de nossos colaboradores, então também oferecemos:

title: TECH LEAD
description:
Somos uma empresa brasileira, com presença internacional, que traz a inovação em seu DNA! Na Biolab, acreditamos que equipes diversas constroem resultados mais sólidos e transformadores. Valorizamos a inclusão e a diversidade em todas as nossas posições . Por isso, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e de todas as identidades, histórias e origens.

Liderar tecnicamente as soluções e os produtos digitais utilizados pelas áreas Industriais, Qualidade, Logística, Backoffice, Financeiro, Compliance e Recursos Humanos, atuando no desenho, priorização, evolução e sustentação dos sistemas corporativos, garantindo qualidade, performance, segurança, integração entre plataformas e alinhamento às necessidades do negócio, além de orientar o time técnico, apoiar decisões de arquitetura, acompanhar entregas, assegurar a aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia e atuar como elo estratégico entre Tecnologia, áreas clientes e fornecedores.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Atuação em processos industriais e integrações entre sistemas corporativos;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum e Kanban);
  • Sólida experiência em Arquitetura de Software (definição de camadas, padrões arquiteturais, APIs e integrações), incluindo APIs REST, Webservices (SOAP), JSON e XML, bem como integrações com ERPs, preferencialmente JD Edwards (JDE);
  • Conhecimento em Git e práticas de versionamento de código;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de documentação técnica (Confluence, Draw.io ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em Cloud (Azure), incluindo ferramental e conceitos de arquitetura;
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de deploy, segurança de aplicações e boas práticas de desenvolvimento seguro.
  • Diferencial: conhecimento em ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (CI/CD), monitoramento e observabilidade (APM, logs e alertas), SEO e infraestrutura básica de sites, governança de mudanças baseada em ITIL, além de visão sistêmica e pensamento arquitetural estruturado.


CONFIRA ABAIXO AS PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES DESTA POSIÇÃO:

  • Desenvolver e aprimorar a arquitetura e os padrões técnicos do ecossistema de dados, por meio da definição de diretrizes, frameworks e boas práticas, visando a manter a escalabilidade, a segurança e a sustentabilidade das soluções tecnológicas;
  • Conduzir projetos e melhorias técnicas de alta complexidade, coordenando múltiplos sistemas e integrações entre as áreas Comercial, Marketing, Comunicação e Customer Service, a fim de otimizar a performance e a confiabilidade dos sistemas;
  • Analisar requisitos funcionais e técnicos, consultando stakeholders e avaliando impactos sistêmicos, para implementar soluções aderentes às arquiteturas corporativas e às necessidades do negócio;
  • Planejar e organizar o desenho das integrações entre sistemas e plataformas, definindo fluxos, APIs e padrões de comunicação, com objetivo de facilitar a interoperabilidade e reduzir riscos operacionais;
  • Supervisionar a estabilidade e a continuidade operacional dos sistemas críticos, acompanhando indicadores de desempenho e capacidade, visando a preservar a disponibilidade e minimizar impactos ao negócio;
  • Conduzir a análise de incidentes de alta complexidade, examinando causas raiz e articulando fornecedores e áreas internas, a fim de mitigar riscos recorrentes e reduzir falhas sistêmicas;
  • Elaborar e revisar documentações técnicas, fluxos, integrações, APIs e mapeamentos, organizando informações estruturadas, para manter a rastreabilidade e facilitar a governança tecnológica;
  • Controlar e verificar a aplicação de boas práticas de versionamento, testes, monitoramento e observabilidade, por meio de auditorias técnicas e acompanhamento de deploys, visando a manter a qualidade e proteger os ambientes produtivos;
  • Ajustar soluções e configurações sistêmicas, avaliando impactos técnicos e regulatórios, para cumprir normas de segurança da informação, requisitos legais e diretrizes corporativas, incluindo LGPD;
  • Participar de ritos ágeis, apresentando direcionamentos técnicos e estimativas estruturadas, com objetivo de contribuir para o planejamento eficiente e a previsibilidade das entregas;
  • Orientar e treinar tecnicamente equipes internas e parceiros, compartilhando padrões e melhores práticas, visando a estimular a autonomia técnica e aumentar a maturidade do time;
  • Pesquisar e avaliar novas tecnologias e soluções de mercado, conduzindo provas de conceito, a fim de implementar inovações que promovam ganhos de eficiência e otimização arquitetural;
  • Supervisionar indicadores de capacidade, performance e disponibilidade dos produtos digitais, analisando métricas e relatórios técnicos, para otimizar recursos e manter níveis adequados de serviço.



Para saber mais sobre nós, acesse e siga nossas redes sociais.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Who we are

We’re a passionate engineering, platform, and operations team, developing and supporting ground-breaking products. Together, we’ll build for the future, creating more opportunities for wellness businesses around the world to help their customers lead full, healthy lives. We push ourselves and our company to always strive for this higher purpose, recognizing the power in working together toward the same goal. We believe in building a diverse company where everyone feels safe bringing their authentic selves to work. And we believe that the secret to success is our people. Join the team, and let’s see what we can accomplish together!


Your role

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll be leading a full stack or backend team focused on one of the key opportunities for Playlist.


You will:

  • Empower your engineering team to deliver a high level of technical quality and business impact.
  • Recruit a diverse team of engineers that are amongst the best in the industry, from outreach to closing.
  • Manage a team of engineers and help develop their careers with stretch responsibilities and excellent feedback.
  • Be actively involved in strategic direction and product decisions for your team.
  • Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives as a member of Playlist's engineering management team.


About the right team member

You are an experienced engineer turned successful people leader who is passionate about creating impactful and high-quality web applications. You have deep experience in at least one aspect of developing a world class web application and you can manage a high performing team through the entire process.


You’ll thrive in this role with experience in:

  • 3+ years of directly managing a full stack or backend engineering team of at least 6 people.
  • Experience shipping high quality websites or mobile applications.
  • You have established the architecture and best practices for web or mobile applications and their backends.
  • You have a proven ability to establish and articulate a vision, set goals, develop and execute.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
The Senior Machine Learning Engineer owns the development and deployment of machine learning solutions and influences the technical direction of their team. They will work closely with Product and Engineering partners in the development of the solution.


  • Lead the development and deployment of Machine Learning solutions to solve business problems.
  • Develop and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable code that meets industry standards
  • Analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights and make informed decisions.
  • Employ state-of-the-art Machine Learning methodologies and frameworks to develop robust and scalable models.
  • Influence technical direction and take ownership of key components of systems and solutions, ensuring that they meet the needs of the business.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders in the development of data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Mentor junior team members to help establish team domain expertise.
  • Contribute to the companys intellectual property and technical leadership through patents and publications at top-tier conferences and journals.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Masters Degree or PhD in CS / ML or related field
  • 3+ years experience in building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production environments at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, feature engineering etc), algorithms/techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization), and experiment design
  • Experience in at least one of these domains: price estimation, personalization, recommender systems, computer vision, fraud detection and authentication, marketing
  • Extensive experience in scientific libraries in Python (numpy, pandas) and Machine Learning tools and frameworks (Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow, Keras, PyTorch)
  • Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Apache Kafka, Spark)
  • Experience with cloud technologies AWS, GCP or Azure

Fluency in Python, SQL


Preferred Requirements:

  • PhD preferred (CS, ML, AI or related field)
  • Background in applying ML techniques to solve real-world business problems in the retail sector.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines.
  • Impact-focused and passionate about delivering high-quality models.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to lead and inspire a team.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Ambiência - Arquitetura
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
  • Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.

title: API Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer API standards and architectural guidelines.


Responsibilities

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Sodexo's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Strategic Finance & Investments – Analyst (Brazil)
description:
Location: Remote (Latin America only – Mexico, Central America, South America)

Compensation: $80,000 to $150,000 USD (base, depending on experience and location)

Experience: 1 to 7 years in Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Venture Capital

*Please apply through the Google form link at the bottom of this page.


Our Platform

We're a thematic holding company backed by the Pritzker Organization focused exclusively on acquiring and scaling category-defining software businesses. Our structure organizes investments into focused portfolios that function as specialized operating groups, each developing deep domain expertise, proven operational playbooks and long-term partnerships with founders and management teams.


We combine operational rigor with a growth equity mindset - partnering closely with leadership teams to drive sustainable ARR growth, profitability improvements and industry-leading customer outcomes.

Our current investment portfolios include:

  • Emergence Mobility Technologies (AutoTech) – Next-generation vehicle acquisition and inventory management platforms
  • Emergence Healthcare Technologies (HCIT) – High-efficiency billing optimization, patient engagement, and clinical care software
  • Emergence Container Technologies (Cloud Infrastructure) – Modern DevOps, observability, and secure cloud performance tools
  • Emergence Procurement Technologies (Supply Chain Tech) – Procurement, logistics, and manufacturing visibility systems


The Role

Strategic Finance & Investments – Analyst

  • Finance at Emergence is not “reporting after the fact.” It is how we make decisions. The bar is high because the work gets used in real rooms with real stakes.
  • This is a hybrid role that sits between investing and strategic finance. You will help build the financial engine across more than 10+ growing portfolio companies in different sectors, including Auto, Healthcare, and Infrastructure Software.
  • It is a great seat for someone early in their career who wants real reps, fast feedback, and a lot of ownership. You will learn quickly because you will have to. You will also get exposed to the CEO and CFO level across U.S. software businesses in addition to the management team at Emergence.


What You Will Spend Your Time Doing

You will do a mix of hands-on building and higher-level thinking, including:

  • Building and maintaining detailed operating models used to forecast performance and guide decisions (revenue, retention, pricing, hiring plans, cash, and scenarios)
  • Standing up “finance infrastructure” that actually works across portfolio companies, including reporting packages, KPI dashboards, budget versus actuals, and forecasting cadences
  • Supporting investor and capital raise work, including preparing materials, cleaning up data rooms, and tightening the metrics story so it holds up under scrutiny
  • Working closely with accounting leaders to improve the quality of the numbers (close hygiene, chart of accounts structure, consistency of definitions, and data integrity)
  • Contributing to new M&A theses and diligence, including market research, unit economics work, and translating messy diligence inputs into clear decision memos


What Makes Someone Successful Here

This is not a role where you can hide behind “good effort.” The models either tie out or they do not.

People who do well here tend to:

  • Take pride in accuracy and consistency, even on the unglamorous stuff
  • Catch issues early and fix them without needing a lot of airtime
  • Ask sharp questions and then go do the work to answer them
  • Communicate clearly in English, both in writing and live, because you will work with U.S.-based executives and investors
  • Stay calm when priorities shift, and still deliver something clean


Requirements

  • 1 to 7 years of IB, PE, or VC experience (or an extremely close equivalent)
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including building models from scratch and stress-testing assumptions
  • Solid accounting and finance fundamentals (you do not need to be a CPA, but you do need to know what you are looking at)
  • Ability to overlap meaningfully with U.S. working hours

description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.

At Phi Partners, we are committed to a collaborative, high-performance culture where professionals work together to deliver complex front-office solutions to elite clients. We specialize in the end-to-end implementation of front-office and risk platforms, from initial requirements gathering to post-go-live support, ensuring that our clients are fully supported throughout the platform lifecycle. Join us as we build the next-generation eTrading team, an ambitious, fast-growing group delivering world-class, complex, and genuinely exciting projects to major financial institutions around the globe. title: Especialista em  Criação
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A Fugini é uma empresa brasileira de alimentos, líder nos segmentos de molhos de tomate e vegetais, que iniciou sua trajetória há quase 30 anos na cidade de Monte Alto, interior de São Paulo. Com atuação totalmente voltada ao mercado nacional, seus produtos estão presentes em todas as regiões do país. Atualmente, a companhia opera com duas unidades fabris equipadas com modernos sistemas de automação: uma em Monte Alto (SP) e outra em Cristalina (GO), inaugurada em 2010 e com 33 mil metros quadrados de área construída. Guiada pelos pilares de inovação, sustentabilidade, saudabilidade e excelência, a Fugini foi pioneira no lançamento de embalagens do tipo sachê para a linha de atomatados - uma das mais eficazes e seguras para a preservação dos alimentos - e a primeira no mundo a embalar vegetais nesse formato. Comprometida em oferecer produtos saudáveis e com rótulo limpo (clean label), a empresa não utiliza conservantes artificiais e promoveu a redução de sal, açúcar e gordura na maioria de suas formulações. Seu portfólio inclui molhos de tomate, vegetais em sachês e latas, molhos especiais, condimentos e outros itens desenvolvidos sob rigorosos padrões de qualidade e segurança alimentar. Para saber mais, acesse fugini.com.br.

  • Assegurar a coerência visual e conceitual das entregas, garantindo consistência de marca em todos os pontos de contato.

Buscamos alguém com:

  • Formação em Design Gráfico, Publicidade e Propaganda, Comunicação Visual ou áreas correlatas.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Hiring: Financial Controller

Company: Confidential

Reports to: CEO/Owner

Status: Full-time/Contract

Location: Remote (Open to those in Argentina, Brazil, Colombia)


Position Overview

Do you love utilizing forecasts to create strategic, financial insights?

Is creating budgets, reports, and maximizing cash flow your jam?

Are you currently employed as a Controller and eager for more fulfilling employment?


Then we would like to meet you!


A small to medium‑sized financial consulting firm is seeking a Controller who can manage core financial operations and help shape the business as it grows. This role combines traditional accounting oversight with leadership of the delivery team that supports clients with financial consulting services.

You’ll be a strong fit if you work well in a fast‑paced environment, take ownership, and balance strategic thinking with precise execution.

The firm serves small businesses ranging from mid‑six to eight figures in revenue across a variety of industries. In this role, you will support both the firm and its client portfolio, ensuring strong financial systems, clear reporting, and consistent delivery across engagements.

Key responsibilities include financial statements, budgeting and forecasting, internal controls, cash flow, payroll, and financial systems management. You will also help guide the consulting delivery team by overseeing financial processes used in client work and supporting the development of scalable delivery practices.

If you enjoy building structure, improving systems, and partnering with leadership to drive growth, this Controller role will be a great fit.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare Financial Statements: Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, ensuring accuracy and full compliance with US GAAP .
  • Financial Forecasting: Build reliable forecasts to project revenues, expenses, and financial trends for both the firm and client engagements.
  • Ensure Compliance: Maintain adherence to legal, regulatory, and internal accounting policies.
  • Manage Accounting Records: Oversee accurate financial records, including AP, AR, and general ledger management.
  • Implement Controls: Develop and enforce internal controls to safeguard assets and ensure data integrity.
  • Monitor Cash Flow: Track and manage cash flow to support operational needs and strategic initiatives.
  • Optimize Cash Utilization: Create strategies to improve liquidity, cash management, and investment decisions.
  • Support Strategic Planning: Provide financial insights that guide business strategy, growth planning, and decision‑making.
  • Evaluate Financial Performance: Analyze financial results and recommend improvements to achieve organizational and client goals.
  • Oversee Financial Systems: Manage and enhance financial software and reporting systems for efficiency and accuracy.
  • US Payroll Oversight: Manage or review W2 and contractor payroll processes to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
  • Lead the Delivery Team: Support and guide the financial consulting delivery team, ensuring consistent processes, high‑quality client work, and scalable operational practices.
  • Shape Operational Practices: Contribute to building and refining the firm’s financial delivery frameworks, systems, and internal processes.
  • Client Financial Services Support: Collaborate with consultants to support client financial operations and ensure strong service delivery across engagements.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of Controller or similar experience in finance or accounting
  • 3+ years of leadership experience , ideally overseeing teams or managing financial operations
  • Strong experience with US GAAP financial reporting
  • Experience with US payroll
  • Has a US CPA equivalent for Argentina, Brazil or Colombia
  • Background in client financial services or financial consulting
  • Strong ownership mindset and accountability
  • Action‑oriented and solution‑focused
  • High attention to detail
  • Collaborative and proactive in working with teams
  • Ambitious, driven, and eager to grow
  • Fast learner with strong adaptability
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced consulting environment


Additional requirements:

  • Located in Argentina, Brazil, or Colombia
  • Available to work between overlapping hours with 10 AM – 6 PM US Central Time Zone
  • Access to a computer and reliable high‑speed internet
  • Distraction‑free work environment
  • Able to prioritize this role as the primary professional focus
  • Demonstrates accountability, openness to feedback, and strong ownership of work and team contributions
  • Communicates professionally and maintains a clear, respectful tone in all correspondence


Offer Details

  • Pay is relative to the market of the country you live in.
  • This is a full-time contract position


Software Utilized by Company

QuickBooks, Gusto, Microsoft Excel, Slack, Google Suite, ClickUp, Puzzle, Causal


Interview Process

  • Complete application
  • Complete assessment
  • Interview virtually with our US-based recruiting firm
  • Interview virtually with the CEO/owner
  • Paid project
  • Final interview with CEO/owner

title: Logistics Analyst
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.


Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.


The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

  • Monitor shipment status and share regular updates with internal teams.
  • Keep the shipment tracking database accurate and up to date.
  • Support logistics and import routines with basic data analysis, reports, and documentation.
  • Assist in the implementation of process improvements to increase efficiency and reliability in logistics operations.


Hard Skills:

  • Experience in logistics, import/export, or supply chain operations.
  • Basic knowledge of international transportation and import processes.
  • Good command of Excel/Sheets and operational tracking tools.
  • Intermediate to advanced English for daily communication.


Soft Skills:

  • Highly Disciplined: Follows routines consistently and meets deadlines.
  • Hands-on & Organized: Comfortable managing multiple shipments and tasks at the same time.
  • Attention to Detail: Ensures accuracy in tracking, data, and documentation.
  • Clear Communication: Shares information objectively and proactively with stakeholders.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience managing complex software delivery projects
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements

Success in This Role

You will succeed if you:

  • Deliver projects on time with strong client satisfaction
  • Help improve client conversion and underwriting outcomes
  • Provide clear structure and direction to engineering teams
  • Identify product improvements that create measurable business impact
  • Build strong relationships with client stakeholders


Why Join Hitch
  • Work directly with major mortgage lenders shaping next-generation lending technology
  • High ownership and direct impact on product and client success
  • Fast-moving startup environment with strong growth opportunity
  • Collaborative, technical, and product-driven culture

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Provisionar e gerenciar infraestrutura no GCP usando Terraform
  • Construir, versionar e otimizar imagens Docker

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Analista (a) Storage - Híbrido
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos


Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


STORAGE JOB DESCRIPTION:


  • Advanced English


  • Good Knowledge on components and architectures.


  • In depth understanding of the HPE Alletra, HP 3PAR, Nimble.


  • Hands on experience with storage array migrations.


  • Experience in SAN storage backup and recovery and exposure to SAN Data replication tools.


  • Experience on Cisco and Brocade fabric switch/Directors. Configuring new switch, upgrades, zoning, VSAN and troubleshooting.


  • Experience of SAN allocation, deallocation.


  • Good Knowledge on RAID concepts, inline data deduplication, inline data compression.


  • Dynamic LUN Provisioning, Zoning, storage firmware upgrades


  • Allocating Boot luns in VMware environment


  • Troubleshooting storage related and compatibility related issues.


  • Allocating LUNs to different operating systems like MS Windows, VMWare ESX/ESXi, Linux and Solaris/AIX/HPUX.


  • Exposure to performance tuning techniques for SAN and NAS


  • Experience in handling major incident bridges, critical issues.


  • Good in scripting and automating the standard storage procedures.


  • Should be familiar with ITIL processes.


Roles & Responsibilities – Storage (HPE 3PAR / Alletra)



1. Design, architect, and deploy HPE 3PAR and Alletra storage solutions based on customer business, performance, and availability requirements.


2. Lead technical discussions with customers and internal stakeholders to understand workload needs and propose optimal storage designs.


3. Manage 3PAR/Alletra arrays including CPGs, virtual volumes, VLUNs, host sets, and port configurations.


4. Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex storage, SAN, and performance issues.


5. Plan and execute storage migrations using Peer Motion, Online Import, and host-based migration tools with minimal downtime.


6. Administer and troubleshoot SAN fabrics (Brocade/Cisco) including zoning, ISLs, firmware upgrades, and fabric resiliency.


7. Optimize storage performance and efficiency through RAID selection, tiering, chunklet layout, and adaptive optimization.


8. Implement and manage replication and DR solutions such as Remote Copy, Peer Persistence, and metro cluster configurations.


9. Integrate storage with virtualization and OS platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, Linux, Windows) and resolve multipathing issues.


10. Manage firmware, OS, and controller upgrades ensuring non-disruptive operations and rollback readiness.


11. Leverage HPE InfoSight and SSMC for proactive monitoring, capacity forecasting, and health analysis.


12. Coordinate with backup teams and customers to integrate storage with Commvault / NetBackup for application-consistent backups.


13. Prepare and deliver technical presentations to customers on storage architecture, performance analysis, and solution proposals.


14. Provide regular operational and executive-level reports covering capacity utilization, performance trends, risks, and recommendations.


15. Act as escalation point for critical production incidents and major outages.


16. Collaborate with application, database, network, and virtualization teams to align storage design with end-to-end solutions.


17. Ensure security, compliance, and governance through encryption, RBAC, audit logging, and best-practice controls.


18. Automate and standardize storage operations using CLI, REST APIs, and scripting to improve efficiency and reliability.


19. Mentor L1/L2 engineers and review change requests, SOPs, and implementation plans.


20. Participate in CAB meetings, customer reviews, and vendor engagements (HPE) while supporting 24×7 mission-critical environments.

title: Senior Demand Planner – FMCG (⚠️Position is based in Angola!)
description:
⚠️International Opportunity! Position is based in Angola!


You will be joining a well-established market leader, large group with diversified businesses portfolio, reporting to the Demand Planning Manager and responsible for the following:


Key Accountabilities:

  • Develop and maintain accurate demand forecasts for decision-making
  • Analyze sales data and market trends to improve forecasting
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on factors that impact demand
  • Monitor sales and refine forecasts based on changing conditions
  • Communicate forecast updates to supply planning teams
  • Take ownership and proactively address data quality issues
  • Create, maintain, and manage visual data tools for leadership


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review and analyze historical sales data to identify trends and patterns that can be used to improve accuracy of future forecasts
  • Collaborate with sales, marketing, and other stakeholders to gather information on upcoming promotions, product launches, and other factors that may impact demand
  • Develop statistical models and algorithms to create accurate demand forecasts for different product types
  • Continuously monitor and track actual sales performance against forecast and make necessary adjustments to the forecast as needed
  • Communicate forecast recommendations and updates to stakeholders across the organization, including senior leadership
  • Ensure that any add/delete items are promptly updated in the system to avoid impacting forecast accuracy
  • Work with IT and Analytics Data teams to ensure that demand data is available on time for extract and analysis
  • Validate that sales forecast is pulled into the correct line
  • Notify the BI team to push data on time to ensure that reporting and analysis can be done in a timely manner
  • Publish LE (latest estimate) forecasts and other relevant reports to keep stakeholders informed of demand trends and performance
  • Develop and maintain demand planning dashboard to provide real-time visibility into forecasting and demand planning metrics.
  • As well as be able to generate reports and visualizations to communicate forecast accuracy, demand trends, and potential risks to stakeholders, enabling informed decision-making
  • Monitor forecast accuracy and identify areas of improvement to enhance the reliability and precision of demand planning
  • Provide training and support to end-users on utilizing the demand planning dashboard, ensuring widespread adoption and utilization across the organization


Key Requirements:

  • Willing and able to work in Angola
  • Bachelor's Degree as a minimum in relevant field including Finance, Math or Engineering; MBA and/or other professional qualifications are highly preferred
  • 4+ years of Demand Planning experience in a large organization
  • Strong understanding of supply chain management, logistics, and inventory / production planning
  • Proficiency in using demand planning and forecasting tools is necessary
  • Proficiency in using forecast accuracy KPIs
  • Strong experience with ERP and demand planning systems (e.g., SAP APO, Oracle Demantra, Kinaxis, Anaplan)
  • Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; experience with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)Knowledge of statistical forecasting methods and demand modeling
  • Solid understanding of distribution networks, inventory management, and supply chain dynamics
  • Familiarity with S&OP processes and cross-functional planning
  • Proficiency in analyzing large sets of data and using data visualization tools to identify trends, patterns, and insight
  • Prior FMCG experience will be a plus
  • Ability to influence the decision makers
  • Highest standards of accuracy and precision
  • Articulate with excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Highly-driven and self-motivated
  • Proven ability to work with ambiguity

title: Especialista em Doenças Florestais
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.


As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).


Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.


Principais atividades:


  • Desenvolver e acompanhar o programa de Fitopatologia, estabelecendo metodologias e procedimentos, visando florestas de alta produtividade e com boa sanidade;
  • Avaliar riscos de doenças e propor estratégias de controle;
  • Realizar diagnósticos técnicos em campo e viveiro e fazer recomendações para o manejo;
  • Propor e acompanhar ensaios de produtos e tecnologias aplicadas ao manejo fitossanitário;
  • Realizar a extensão dos resultados da Pesquisa para a área operacional, apoiando na implantação;
  • Capacitar equipes de campo e viveiro em boas práticas de manejo e controle;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e apresentar resultados para as áreas de operação e gestão.

  • Conhecimento técnico sobre manejo integrado de doenças de eucalipto;
  • Pacote Office;

title: Executivo de vendas
description:

Nós entendemos sua ambição e o Salem Advogados vai ao encontro dela. Você pode crescer muito mais em uma empresa em ascensão como a nossa!

+5.000 processos ativos (fora os arquivados)

+85.000 novos leads por ano

+10 anos de experiência jurídica

+40 colaboradores na equipe


---------------

Detalhes sobre a vaga


  • Temos um software de CRM funil de vendas (Pipedrive) que permite registrar informações chave para facilitar criar o relacionamento
  • Já temos os leads gerados
  • O time comercial é estruturado em qualificador, fechador e pós-venda
  • Esta vaga é focada em vendas/fechador. Identificar as objeções e garantir o contrato.
  • Não gerará leads, não qualificará os leads, não fará pós-vendas depois de fechado o contrato
  • O foco é especializar para ganhar eficiência
  • No entanto, não temos cultura de braço curto. “Isso não faz parte da minha vaga” não existe aqui
  • Meta é inegociável, tem que ser batida


---------------

Candidato ideal


Há tipos diferentes de perfil de lead potencial, por isto é essencial que você tenha:

  • Capacidade analítica para entender qual lead fecha contrato e qual não fecha;
  • Capacidade analítica para entender o motivo do lead não ter fechado e ir participando da melhoria do script. Não basta apenas ligar usando o mesmo script sem entender o que está acontecendo
  • Capacidade de criar relatórios (o próprio software de vendas possui modelos prontos), com o objetivo de entender qual perfil fecha mais ou menos para focar no melhor perfil de cliente
  • Desenvolver relacionamento a fundo com clientes (rapport, aprender sobre o cliente)
  • Entender a necessidade do cliente e não apenas insistir na venda, mas construir relacionamento


---------------

Qualificações


  • 3+ anos de experiência em vendas
  • Excelente skill de comunicação
  • Habilidade de se auto-organizar e de priorização de trabalho (qual perfil de lead fecha mais e focar nestes)
  • Capacidade de analisar dados, fazer relatórios e tirar conclusões de métricas de vendas

title: Analista de Infraestrutura (Cloud - OCI)
description:

  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado de performance e conectividade, garantindo o menor tempo de resposta em incidentes.

description:

Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

description:

We are looking for Oracle EBS Finance Functional Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities):

  • Understand existing SAP Financial structures to design accurate mapping to Oracle EBS.

2. Data Conversion & Mapping

  • Lead functional activities for end‑to‑end data migration cycles (Extract–Transform–Load).
  • Define conversion mapping rules from SAP data elements to Oracle EBS financial objects.
  • Review data profiling results and identify gaps or anomalies.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to finalize conversion design documents (MD50/MD70).

3. Validation & Reconciliation

  • Validate converted data in Oracle EBS test environments.
  • Perform financial data reconciliations (trial balance, open transactions, subledger balances).
  • Support mock conversions, SIT, and UAT cycles.

4. Cross‑Functional Coordination

  • Work closely with SAP functional teams to understand data structures, dependencies, and transformation logic.
  • Partner with business users to confirm functional expectations and sign‑off on migrated data.
  • Collaborate with technical developers, DB teams, and cutover managers.

5. Cutover & Go‑Live Support

  • Prepare conversion runbooks and validation checklists.
  • Support cutover planning, execution, and post‑go‑live activities.
  • Troubleshoot issues related to financial data in Oracle EBS.


Mandatory Skills

  • Advanced English
  • Experience with EBS R12 upgrade & Implementation Oracle projects.
  • Prior experience in multi country/multi ledger implementations.
  • Ability to read and validate SQL queries (basic to intermediate level).
  • Experience reviewing MD50/MD70/ADI templates.
  • Familiarity with interface programs, APIs, and financial open transactions.
  • Proven experience in at least one large SAP → Oracle EBS migration or multi system financial conversion project.
  • Strong understanding of financial data flows, chart of accounts, ledger setups, subledger architectures, and accounting rules.

  • Planejamento e execução de manutenções preventivas e corretivas , com acompanhamento de equipes terceirizadas.
  • Gestão de obras e pequenas reformas: abrigos, salas, canaletas, adequações civis para instalações elétricas, entre outras.
  • Garantia de conformidade com normas ambientais, urbanísticas e de segurança .
  • Elaboração e atualização de planilhas, relatórios, checklists e indicadores.
  • Gestão de demandas via software específico de manutenção predial.


✅ Requisitos:

  • Curso Técnico em Edificações completo .

title: Senior People Operations Associate
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity

Job Description

The Role

Cint seeks a Senior People Operations Associate to join our People Operations, reporting to the People Operations Manager. The Senior People Operations Associate is responsible for:

As a Senior People Operations Associate, you will work closely with the Global People Team supporting them on internal employee queries, be part of various processes (on and off boarding, changes in employment, working with local People Partners supporting local processes), and own administrative work. You will thrive working in a fast-paced environment and enjoy contributing towards building exceptional employer branding. The successful candidate will be a self-starter who loves building relationships, has verbose technical acumen, a passion for streamlining processes, and provides excellent customer service internally with the top-notch candidate and employee experience externally.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a company where you can make an impact, working in a diverse People function and being part of an innovative team.
What You Will Do

  • Execute new employee onboarding, including offer documentation and contracts
  • Execute leaver offboarding processes and coordinate with other functions for a smooth exit.
  • Keep a track record of leaves such as sick, vacation or maternity in HRIS
  • Be the First point of contact with employees on HR-related issues
  • Represent People Organisation to the business providing local expertise in local laws and regulations.
  • Organize, maintain and update internal databases with digital personnel records of relevant employee information.
  • Contribute to the creation and maintenance of various internal HR processes.
  • Update, maintain, and present reports with KPIs such as turnover rates and hires by each department/region and be able to provide insights and proactive improvements.
  • Support the Payroll department by providing employee information, leaves and employee benefits.
  • Liaise with local IT for hardware issue and collection when needed
  • Support new hires and leavers during their onboarding and offboarding remotely and in person when needed
  • Review and prepare Payroll changes for Payroll processing.
  • Maintain and administer local benefits.
  • Execute background checks and other pre-employment screening.
  • Prepare correspondence, arrange meetings, and process confidential reports and documents.
  • Handle all employee queries, written or verbal with the utmost confidentiality.
Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • Proven experience as an HR Administrator/Support or relevant role for at least 3 years.
  • Proven experience in Payroll and Benefits tasks globally.
  • Digital literate with expertise in using Google Suite and MS Office applications.
  • Excellent organizational skills, with an ability to prioritize important projects.
  • Excellent communication skills for in-person, email, and telephone calls.
  • Excellent skills in written English to create reports and meet tight deadlines.
  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in HR required.
  • An excellent learner with the ability to work in teams.
  • Good problem-solving skills.
  • Basic knowledge of the recruitment process.
  • Present information in forms, tables, and spreadsheets.


Bonus Points If You Have

  • Professionals in Human Resources (PHR), or other HR certifications, are preferred.
  • Thorough knowledge of labour relations and laws.
  • Skilled in performance management and employee benefits administration.
  • Proficiency in using HR software like HRIS or HRMS.
